_about: Ground truth for scoring: which real machine each record belongs to, and the cases planted on purpose.

planted.case: Same laptop in three tools: short name in one, full domain name in another; serial number and MAC address link them
Okta shows a friendly device name ("Priya's MacBook Pro"); only the serial number links it
Scanner saw the laptop under a generic name on another network; only the MAC address links it
A phone seen only by Okta
planted.expect: listed separately, not counted in coverage

planted.case: Scanner sees an AWS-style name (ip-10-0-1-15), EDR sees web-prod-01; only the cloud instance ID links them
Two different servers both named app-01 (production and staging) with different instance IDs
Production database server with no endpoint agent
Same file server, but its IP changed between the two tools and nothing else links them
A server not seen in 120 days
Domain controller in both tools; same hostname and a shared IP link them
A machine with the endpoint agent that the scanner never saw
A finding points to an asset ID missing from the asset export
Tenable console shows 2 more assets than the export returned
